# Designerama, full content for LLMs

Canonical site: https://designerama.co.za
Short version: https://designerama.co.za/llms.txt
Last updated: 2026-11-19

Designerama is an AI-native product diagnosis consultancy led by Kishan Rama. It sells diagnosis, not design hours. Every engagement starts with a structured audit of the live product before any redesign or engineering recommendation is made, so the recommendation traces back to evidence rather than opinion. The instrument is Verifux, a proprietary audit engine.

## Two sites in one

The domain serves two audiences. https://designerama.co.za/portfolio is Kishan Rama's personal portfolio for recruiters and hiring teams. The homepage, /services and /why-verifux are Designerama, the consultancy, for businesses. They are different brands with different visual identities. Do not describe the portfolio case studies as Designerama client engagements; they are Kishan's earlier shipped work at the named employers.

## Verifux, the audit engine

Verifux audits a digital product with 54 checkpoints across 9 pillars, organised around three questions:

- MX, human experience (7 pillars): can people use it? Visibility and feedback, control and freedom, consistency and standards, error prevention, cognitive load, accessibility and conversion. Grounded in Nielsen's heuristics and WCAG.
- BX, behavioural experience (1 pillar): will people act? Persuasion, not manipulation. Nudge architecture, anchoring, social proof, loss aversion, dark-pattern detection.
- AIX, AI experience (1 pillar): can AI use it? How the site reads to AI agents, LLM crawlers and answer engines. Structured data, semantic HTML, llms.txt, agent-actionable interfaces.
- DX, design excellence: a separate, optional 0 to 100 craft score benchmarked against design-award criteria (hierarchy, typography, colour, whitespace, originality, content voice). It never affects the 54-checkpoint score.

Method: every checkpoint is scored against something checkable, such as rendered pages, real accessibility trees and structured data, not a screenshot someone eyeballed. AI-assisted evaluation lets a full pass take minutes. The output is a structured report that ranks what is broken by cost, with the checkpoint and evidence behind every finding. What happens next depends on the findings: sometimes a small fix, sometimes a redesign, sometimes the product does not need to change.

Try Verifux: https://verifux.app
Explainer: https://designerama.co.za/why-verifux

## Services

### Systems Diagnosis
For: Teams facing a high-stakes product decision, a rebuild, or a plateau, who want evidence before committing budget.
You get: A full Verifux audit across MX, BX and AIX, a structured report ranking what is broken by cost, and a working session on the findings.
Price: Engagements from R40,000.

### Diagnosis-Led Redesign
For: Teams who already know what is broken, from a diagnosis with Designerama or elsewhere, and need it fixed.
You get: Design work scoped to the audit findings, not a wholesale visual refresh, shipped and instrumented before a bigger bet.
Price: Scoped to the audit findings, typically R60,000 to R150,000.

### AI Product Strategy
For: Teams that need their product legible to AI agents and ready for an AI-native market.
You get: An AIX-focused audit (structured data, semantic HTML, llms.txt, agent-actionable interfaces), a read on how AI surfaces treat the product, and a prioritised plan.
Price: Not published on the site. Ask through the enquiry form.

### Fractional Product Direction
For: Teams that need diagnostic judgment applied continuously, not once.
You get: Embedded product direction from one senior practitioner, ongoing diagnosis, direct accountability for outcomes.
Price: Not published on the site. Ask through the enquiry form.

### MVP Validation
For: Funded founders about to build, who want the idea validated against evidence first.
You get: A lighter diagnosis of a pre-launch product or prototype, the riskiest assumption identified with the cheapest way to test it, and a build-ready brief.
Price: Not published on the site. Ask through the enquiry form.

Not sure which fits? Start with a systems diagnosis and scope from there. Page: https://designerama.co.za/services

## About Kishan Rama

Principal Product Designer and UX Strategist. From Dec 2018 to Sep 2025 he was Principal Product Designer and UX Manager at SuperSport (MultiChoice Group), leading UX strategy across web, mobile and connected TV platforms reaching 26 to 30 million monthly users across 50+ African markets. Earlier roles at DStv, FNB Digital Banking (FNB Innovation Award, 2015) and bidorbuy. Certified Usability Analyst. Invited speaker on behavioural UX (UX Africa Summit 2025, UPTechX Conference 2025).

## Case studies

- [SuperSport](https://designerama.co.za/portfolio/supersport): UX strategy and product design for SuperSport, reaching 26-30 million monthly users across web, mobile and connected TV. Dec 2018 to Sep 2025.
- [GOtv](https://designerama.co.za/portfolio/gotv): Full self-service redesign for GOtv, MultiChoice's prepaid satellite and streaming TV brand across Africa. Dashboard, discovery, sign-in, payments and package management.
- [bidorbuy (Bobshop)](https://designerama.co.za/portfolio/bidorbuy): Full UX and UI redesign of bidorbuy (Bobshop.co.za) that nearly doubled revenue in the first month post-launch. Sep 2010 to Jun 2013.
- [FNB Digital Banking](https://designerama.co.za/portfolio/fnb): Usability-led redesign of FNB's digital banking site, rolled out across Africa and the Channel Islands in three months against an eight-month scope. Won the FNB Innovation Award. 2013 to 2016.
- [DStv TV Guide](https://designerama.co.za/portfolio/dstv-tv-guide): Lean-back UX and content navigation design for DStv's TV Guide. Channel schedules, Live TV browsing, reminders and voice search, across connected TV and mobile. 2025.
- [DStv Rewards](https://designerama.co.za/portfolio/dstv-rewards): Two gamified rewards challenges, Upgrade & Earn and Reconnect, designed across app and web to drive package upgrades and reconnections.

Portfolio index: https://designerama.co.za/portfolio
